reason: A pre-injection external-DP wave-boundary timeout invalidated the long v4 sweep. Native model code is unchanged; resident admission is now atomic through installed pause/resume APIs.
model_ready_arrival: CPU rendering outside victim loop; GPU vision encoder enabled
session_limit: At most 48 frozen waves including warmup, imposed before measurements; no fastest-run selection or automatic retry.
slo_proxy: peak response-window ITL <= 1.5 times paired decode-only median ITL
best_lp: Pool AUTO/G4 observations as one identical algorithm. Minimum TTFT among configurations meeting 1.5x peak SLO proxy; if none, minimum peak VSEL.
selection_data: 3-repeat discovery per arm, before final 10 repeats; no final-test selection.
ep_common: Same material EP residual in tuned CP/LP, excluding producer readiness, frontend and integration overhead.
modality_common: Matched-token visual penalty in both CP and LP, with the same attributable physical cause, not client polling.
ci_unit: paired repeat/wave with restart-block sensitivity; never individual layers
